title: Jack Parsons reads The Golden Bough and concludes science is a form of magic

tellings.quote: And Jack Parsons actually read uh this book called The Golden Bow by JG Frasier, this 19th century anthropologist.

plain: The rocket pioneer Jack Parsons read The Golden Bough, a study of magic and religion by J.G. Frazer, a 19th-century anthropologist, and came away seeing science as a form of magic. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as part of the idea that early rocketry and the occult were tangled together.
